prompt: A CI job ran the test suite of this repository and left its JUnit XML report in report.xml; the suite fails. Find the defects in the application code under warehouse/ and fix them there, not in the tests or in pytest.ini. Finish when every test passes.
setup: uv venv .venv -q && uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python pytest==9.1.1 && { .venv/bin/pytest --junitxml=report.xml -o junit_logging=all -q -p no:cacheprovider tests >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -s report.xml ]; }
verify: [ "$(cat tests/*.py pytest.ini | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 6b87ef40117ec55c8eaf378ab080981f6ffb20d86391baee4329ecad762aab1c ] && [ "$(ls tests | grep -c '\.py$')" = 5 ] && .venv/bin/pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -Eq '^44 passed in '
solution:
/usr/bin/python3 -I -c "def sub(p, a, b):
    s = open(p).read(); assert a in s, p; open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(a, b))
sub('warehouse/stock.py', 'if qty >= free:', 'if qty > free:')
sub('warehouse/shipping.py', 'grams / 100', 'grams / 1000')
sub('warehouse/sku.py', '    warehouse, code, number = text.strip().upper().split("-")
', '    parts = text.strip().upper().split("-")
    if len(parts) not in (3, 4):
        raise ValueError(f"bad sku {text!r}")
    warehouse, code, number = parts[:3]
    size = parts[3] if len(parts) == 4 else ""
    if size and size not in SIZES:
        raise ValueError(f"bad size in {text!r}")
')
sub('warehouse/sku.py', 'Sku(warehouse, code, int(number))', 'Sku(warehouse, code, int(number), size)')
"
control: - After each change, regenerate the report with `.venv/bin/pytest --junitxml=report.xml -o junit_logging=all -q tests >/dev/null`, then read it with `cat report.xml`.
squeeze: - After each change, regenerate the report with `.venv/bin/pytest --junitxml=report.xml -o junit_logging=all -q tests >/dev/null`, then read it with `squeeze < report.xml` and read squeeze's output instead of the report.
